query: 'SELECT
    a.admission_id AS admission_id_bk,
    p.paciente_key,
    dep.departamento_key,
    CASE WHEN d.diagnosis_id IS NULL
         THEN sd.diagnostico_key
         ELSE dx.diagnostico_key
    END AS diagnostico_key,
    CONVERT(int, CONVERT(char(8), a.admission_date, 112)) AS fecha_ingreso_key,
    CONVERT(int, CONVERT(char(8), a.discharge_date, 112)) AS fecha_alta_key,
    a.attending_doctor_id AS medico_id,
    DATEDIFF(day, a.admission_date, a.discharge_date) AS dias_estancia,
    1 AS conteo_admisiones
FROM silver.admissions AS a
LEFT JOIN gold.dim_paciente AS p
    ON p.patient_id_bk = a.patient_id
LEFT JOIN gold.dim_departamento AS dep
    ON dep.nombre_departamento = TRIM(a.department)
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP (1) diagnosis_id, icd_code, diagnosis_description, severity
    FROM silver.diagnoses
    WHERE admission_id = a.admission_id
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(icd_code), '') IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY diagnosis_id
) AS d
LEFT JOIN gold.dim_diagnostico AS dx
    ON dx.codigo_icd = TRIM(d.icd_code)
   AND dx.nivel_severidad = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(d.severity), ''), 'Sin especificar')
   AND (
       dx.descripcion_patologia = NULLIF(TRIM(d.diagnosis_description), '')
       OR (dx.descripcion_patologia IS NULL
           AND NULLIF(TRIM(d.diagnosis_description), '') IS NULL)
   )
LEFT JOIN gold.dim_diagnostico AS sd
    ON sd.codigo_icd = 'SIN_DIAGNOSTICO'',
